title: Record page: the owner shows twice when a field group draws owner_id (header meta line plus the group's field)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Found while building PR #35938 (#35891 + #35849). Part of epic #35590 (record page redo).

## What a user sees
On a record page, the header's meta line always shows the record's owner. When the object's declared field groups also place `owner_id` in the body, the reader sees the owner twice: once in the meta line and once as a field in the group. #28868 ("owner once") asked for the owner to appear once.

This happens on `main` today and isn't caused by #35938. That PR was asked for neither part, so it leaves both as they are.

## To decide / do
Choose the single place the owner appears when the body draws `owner_id`. One option is for the meta line to skip the owner whenever a field group renders `owner_id`. Then build that choice, with a test that renders a record whose group holds `owner_id` and counts the owner exactly once.

## Acceptance
- A record page whose field groups include `owner_id` shows the owner once.
- A record page whose groups leave `owner_id` out still shows the owner in the meta line.

Reader: `domain:ui` (plugin-detail / record page).
